tenure_definition: tenure_months = (end.year - start.year) * 12 + (end.month - start.month) + 1, end = canceled_at if set else as_of; slot 01's 14 equals its 14 succeeded subscription rows. PILOT = CHURNED with tenure_months <= 3.
enterprise_count_note: Slots 01, 02, 04, 05 carry a MOCK headcount_range with lower bound > 1000. All twelve logo companies are fictional; their Akta records are hand-written MOCK fixtures under demo_cache/akta/mock/.

matching.tiers: alias/exact -> normalized (strip punctuation and legal suffixes) exact -> difflib >= 0.92 with >= 0.08 margin over runner-up -> NOT_IN_LEDGER
